preconditions.description: The board dimension n is an integer between 3 and 1000 inclusive.
The queen's coordinates (ax, ay) are within the board boundaries.
The king's starting coordinates (bx, by) are within the board boundaries.
The target coordinates (cx, cy) are within the board boundaries.
The king does not start on the queen's square.
The target is not the queen's square.
The target is not the king's starting square.

preconditions.expression: not (ax == bx or ay == by or abs(ax - bx) == abs(ay - by))
preconditions.description: The king's starting position is not in check (not on same row, column, or diagonal as queen).

preconditions.expression: not (ax == cx or ay == cy or abs(ax - cx) == abs(ay - cy))
preconditions.description: The target position is not in check.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' if (ax < min(bx, cx) or ax > max(bx, cx)) and (ay < min(by, cy) or ay > max(by, cy)) else stdout.strip() == 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if the queen's row and column both lie strictly outside the bounding box defined by the start and end points of the king's path, meaning the queen does not block the rectangular region between start and target; otherwise output 'NO'.
